github.description: GitHub MCP server. Launcher self-loads GITHUB_TOKEN from root .env when the shell that launched the client didn't export it (no direnv here), mirroring run-openthrottle-mcp.sh. No env block: an unexpanded ${GITHUB_TOKEN} placeholder is what triggers the client's 'Failed to replace env in config' warning, and the launcher handles both exported and .env token sources.

maestro.description: Maestro E2E testing (maestro.dev). Drive the openthrottle-developer app: list_devices, inspect_screen, take_screenshot, run flows, cheat_sheet, and Maestro Cloud tools. Requires the Maestro CLI on PATH and a running app/device.

openthrottle-mcp.description: OpenThrottle (OT) plans knowledge base (Postgres + GraphQL). Plans, tasks, notes, commit links, activity, output stream, semantic search, health. No env block, for the same reason as the github entry: an unexpanded ${VAR} placeholder is what triggers the client's 'Missing environment variables' / 'Failed to replace env in config' warning, and the launcher already owns resolution. API_URL and API_URL_INTERNAL would be discarded regardless (the launcher probes for a live server and exports both itself); ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read nowhere in openthrottle-mcp; and OPENTHROTTLE_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN is inherited from the launching shell when exported, else self-loaded from this worktree's .env or the root checkout's.

openthrottle-mcp-docker.description: HTTP transport for the containerized OT MCP server (docker --profile prod up mcp). "type" is REQUIRED: without it Claude Code skips this entry entirely ('has a url but no type'), which silently dropped the server from every session.
